VillaCheck ให้บริการตรวจสอบข้อมูลที่พัก: VillaCheck provides property information checks. It does not take bookings or receive accommodation payments. Verification statuses reflect documents reviewed by admins and subscription validity at the time shown. They do not guarantee bookings or protection from fraud. Merchants must have rights to their documents and submit accurate information. Package fees are paid after document approval, and services activate after an admin confirms payment evidence. Check invoice amounts and periods before paying. Demo data and test payments are for testing only; do not transfer real money for them. For corrections or service fee questions, contact villacheck69@gmail.com.
